# A backfill of 6 days leaves out the three days that cannot load: day 3 fails at the source, day 5 has odd labels (all unsure), day 6 has a broken label file.
# Each of them is retried alone with partition.star. The odd day waits for a person. A load of the same input a second time changes nothing,
# and a load that fails in the middle rolls back and leaves the earlier rows.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sqlite3] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

pipeinit
pipefakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env PIPE_DIR=$WORK/pl
env PIPE_HOME=$WORK/pipe
cp mode-unsure mode-2026-04-05
cp mode-short mode-2026-04-06

exec obeereal item add pipeline bf-1 --title 'April' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run bf-1 pipeline --workflow pl/backfill.star
stdout 'item bf-1 finished'
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT group_concat(day) FROM manifest ORDER BY day'
stdout '^2026-04-01,2026-04-02,2026-04-04$'
# The odd day did not wait inside the chunk, so the backfill finished.
grep -count=1 '^classify 2026-04-05$' calls.log

# Day 3: the source answers again, and the day runs alone.
rm src/fail-2026-04-03
exec obeereal item add pipeline day-3 --title 'Retry April 3' --body-file day3.json
exec obeereal run day-3 pipeline --workflow pl/partition.star
stdout 'item day-3 finished'
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT version FROM manifest WHERE day = "2026-04-03"'
stdout '^2$'
grep -count=1 '^classify 2026-04-03$' calls.log

# Day 6: the labels are fixed at the agent, and the day runs alone.
rm mode-2026-04-06
exec obeereal item add pipeline day-6 --title 'Retry April 6' --body-file day6.json
exec obeereal run day-6 pipeline --workflow pl/partition.star
stdout 'item day-6 finished'

# Day 5: the run asks, and the answer load loads the day with its unsure labels.
exec obeereal item add pipeline day-5 --title 'Retry April 5' --body-file day5.json
exec obeereal run day-5 pipeline --workflow pl/partition.star &
waitstatus 'paused: Day 2026-04-05'
exec obeereal answer day-5 load
wait
stdout 'item day-5 finished'
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM labeled WHERE day = "2026-04-05" AND label = "unsure"'
stdout '^3$'
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manifest'
stdout '^6$'

# The same input at the same version changes nothing.
env PIPE_VERSION=2
exec sh pl/scripts/load.sh 2026-04-02
stdout 'unchanged: 2026-04-02 is loaded at version 2'

# A load that fails in the middle rolls back. The labels file has an id twice, so the insert breaks its key after the old rows were deleted.
cp dup.jsonl pipe/stage/2026-04-02/labels.jsonl
env PIPE_VERSION=3
! exec sh pl/scripts/load.sh 2026-04-02
stderr 'rolled back'
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) || " " || (SELECT version FROM manifest WHERE day = "2026-04-02") FROM labeled WHERE day = "2026-04-02"'
stdout '^3 2$'

-- body.txt --
2026-04-01 2026-04-06
-- day3.json --
{"day":"2026-04-03"}
-- day5.json --
{"day":"2026-04-05"}
-- day6.json --
{"day":"2026-04-06"}
-- mode-unsure --
unsure
-- mode-short --
short
-- dup.jsonl --
{"id":"20260402-1","label":"bug"}
{"id":"20260402-1","label":"bug"}
{"id":"20260402-2","label":"bug"}
-- src/fail-2026-04-03 --
-- pipe/config --
SOURCE_API=http://source.test
-- pipe/credential.header --
X-Token: TESTONLY
